title: paeonia delavayi var. lutea
intro: Paeonia delavayi var. lutea, commonly known as the Golden Tree Peony, is a variety of flowering plant in the Paeonia genus. It is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Paeonia delavayi var. lutea include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which can help to alleviate menstrual cramps and other symptoms associated with menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include paeoniflorin, paeonol, and paeonilin, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory properties.
